description: Redux reducer module for managing general entity states in Mattermost, including config, license, custom profile attributes, server version, admin setup status, and CWS availability.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Reducer for handling client configuration state.

methods.name: license
methods.description: Reducer for handling client license state.

methods.name: customProfileAttributes
methods.description: Reducer for managing custom user profile attribute fields.

methods.name: serverVersion
methods.description: Reducer for storing server version string.

methods.name: firstAdminVisitMarketplaceStatus
methods.description: Reducer for tracking first admin marketplace visit status.

methods.name: firstAdminCompleteSetup
methods.description: Reducer for tracking completion of first admin setup.

methods.name: cwsAvailability
methods.description: Reducer for CWS (Cloud Web Services) availability status.
